mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to show past, current and projected finances."
Financial records are used to show past, current and projected finances.

The income statement is an excellent tool for assessing your business.

Owning a business is the dream of many people.

Spring is a better time to introduce a service.

The three-year income projection is a pro forma income statement (profit and loss statement for more information, see Income Statement).

Product liability is a major consideration, especially in certain industries.

The narrative template is the body of the business plan.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the point at which a company's expenses exactly match its sales or service volume."
Break-Even Analysis (BEA) The break-even point is the point at which a company's expenses exactly match its sales or service volume.

Indirect competition is a company with the same product or service but with a different target market.

Analyzing the market is a way to gather facts about potential customers and to determine the demand for your product or service.
